create_pipeline_text_segmentation: create a TextSegmentationPipeline that segments text into sentences using spaCy for a given language
create_pipeline_text_to_embedding: create a HFTextToEmbeddingPipeline that encodes text into vector embeddings using the Sonar encoder model
create_pipeline_embedding_to_text: create an HFEmbeddingToTextPipeline that decodes vector embeddings back into text using the Sonar decoder model
run_pipeline_process_batch: run a pipeline's process_batch method to transform text columns with segmentation or embedding operations
build_pipeline_with_factory: build a text processing pipeline using TextSegmentationPipelineFactory, TextToEmbeddingPipelineFactory, or EmbeddingToTextPipelineFactory
